description: Still standing start; smooth0–10m build, relaxed10–20m rhythm, gradual20–35m runoff and protected return/recovery. Easy2→3/3 context, or2→4/4 after actual repeatable prior whole easy running for the first increase, or retention of actual repeatable compatible whole4 running. No reconstructed historical3 record is demanded for the retained4 path. No maximal second half, fly threshold or timed test.

setup: Still comfortable bilateral standing start with relaxed natural arms and a known straight route. No rolling, three-point, falling or reactive start is added.
Identify markers, selected context, runoff, outside return and stop cue; no extra athlete trial.
Verify exact-profile evidence and actual facility/traffic.
executionSteps: Build smoothly over 0–10 m: easy context about 2/10 toward 3/10; independently qualified modest-intent context about 2/10 toward 4/10. No maximal start or forced early upright posture.
Retain relaxed selected effort over 10–20 m: about 3/10 easy or 4/10 in the qualified context. Natural coordinated running and arms; no fly threshold, timed result or maximal second half.

Reduce speed gradually through 20–35 m. Do not force an abrupt stop at 35 m or shorten runoff for the clock. If actual effort no longer fits the retained protected route, hold/reduce, explicitly reconfigure or defer.
Exit by the declared protected path, then use the separate one-way outside return and full recovery. Return turns and staging are logistics, not extra technical or cutting repetitions.
coachingExecution.armAndContactPolicy: Relaxed natural reciprocal arms and coordinated contacts; no forced stride/cadence/height.
coachCues: Stay relaxed at the selected effort.
stopSigns: Stop for pain, symptoms, acute tightness/pull sensation, limp, apprehension/participant request, stumble, unsafe surface/traffic, misunderstood conduct or restriction conflict.

End the affected attempt or intent progression for lost coordination, uncontrolled contacts, forced posture/overstride, maximal racing or inability to slow gradually within sufficient protected space.
Record all actual/partial work. No extra attempt, faster return or shortened rest repairs a fault. Use remaining time for safe clearance, explanation or recovery.
If actual route, runoff, sightline, return or pace no longer fits, delay/omit or hold/reduce. No forced stopping deadline or silent corridor extension.
coachingExecution.countRule: Count every attempt, including partial/faulted work. Record actual build/rhythm/runoff/exit/return, intended/reported effort, contacts, distance, time and response. Zero prescribed jump-drill repetitions is not zero cyclic running flight, contacts or impact; actual contact totals remain null until observed.

retainedStrengthContext.familiarTwoDBGate: Actual most recent compatible TWO-dumbbell record at the same pair/load/range/count with independently controlled pickup, top start, hinge repetitions and set-down, plus suitable current response. DB.setup: Five individually fitting elevated pickup/parking stations with TEN simultaneously suitable DBs at actual retained pairs/loads. One DB in each hand, palms facing inward, long arms and tall top stand with weights near thighs. Soft knees and organized trunk; move hips back with the DBs close through the actual owned hamstring-limited range. No floor-touch target or new range/handling test.
DB.nextRowReuse: Only after all hip work is parked/cleared during later row setup; actual suitable loads still required.
DB.sourceVsAuthorContext: Source331 verifies dumbbell-standard-tempo with TWO dumbbells on close independent paths and declared owned hamstring-limited range; related legacy RDL instructions explain hip-height start, soft knees, keeping load close and stopping before spinal compensation rather than reaching the floor. Palms-in/long-arm wording, fitting elevated pickup, handling clock and this small dose are explicitly declared OR08 session context, not a newly verified mandatory source profile.
